notes: Posted 10 August 2001 with Coruscant-set cards (Darth Maul, Young Apprentice, Allegations Of Corruption, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay), so the format is Premiere - Coruscant.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start': Bring Him Before Me ('BHBM'), Death Star II: Throne Room ('DS2throne'), Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses ('prepped defenses'), Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Crush The Rebellion and I Will Find Them Quickly, Master; all count toward the total.

The start line 'I will find them quickly master/if the trace was correct' names two cards: the Effect I Will Find Them Quickly, Master and the Interrupt If The Trace Was Correct, which the strategy takes into hand with it from Reserve Deck before activating. Both are counted, so the list totals 61 as published.

Posted 'id just as soon mount a wookie' dested the Dark Hoth interrupt I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (the strategy uses it to return Luke to hand); 'vader with stick' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'darklord' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'sim shady' Sim Aloo; 'darth maul, young whippersnapper' Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; 'mauling stick' Maul's Lightsaber.

Posted 'sense/uncertain' dested Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'you cant hide forever/mobpoints' You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points (the strategy calls it 'the combo card'); 'you are beaten down upon' You Are Beaten; 'FOIL force lightning' Force Lightning; 'limited res' Limited Resources; 'circle' The Circle Is Now Complete; 'ghhk' Ghhhk; 'evadermonnok' Evader & Monnok; 'hell to pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'CHYBC' the Effect Come Here You Big Coward.

Posted 'mos espaDB' dested the Dark Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Dark); 'ccDB' the Dark Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'imp holotable' Imperial Holotable; 'mauls landing site' Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (the strategy: 'i threw in landing site as well, for the drain and the force').

Byline 'Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag' looks like a joke name (Geburtstag is German for birthday), so the deck is credited to the handle .prototype. with no player page, as with decks 19667, 19770, 19835 and 19965.
